programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From May until July of 1984, Alton Coleman and his common law wife, Denise Brown, engaged in a gruesome crime spree that spanned six states and left eight people dead including children. The FBI coordinated law enforcement efforts throughout the entire country in order to track the couple. Their expertise in conducting manhunts for the nation's most horrible killers paid off. The couple was located and apprehended as they prepared to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A young mother and her infant son mysteriously disappeared from their home. The woman's husband was the only suspect, but he was eventually cleared. There was no solid evidence that a crime had even been committed. Six months later, a local farmer found the remains of the missing woman and her child. Both had been murdered. Agents and local police had only one tiny piece of evidence, an unidentified hair found in the murdered woman's car. The hair was too small for analysis.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1980, the FBI began a massive undercover operation, code named Safebet, that was designed to expose the Chicago Mafia's infiltration into the city's surrounding suburbs. Undercover agents quickly discovered that the mob had its tentacles spread into every facet of the law enforcement community. They unwittingly uncovered the murder of a wealthy socialite perpetrated by a jealous and greedy mob lawyer and covered up by the local police chief.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After a series of brutal bank robberies and murders in south Miami during the mid-1980's, the FBI embarked on an exhaustive eight-month investigation. With little evidence and no suspects, agents were willing to try anything to find the violent perpetrators. On April 11, 1986, agents conducting routine surveillance spotted the vehicle used in the bank robberies. They attempted to arrest the two suspects in the car. What followed was the bloodiest firefight in FBI history.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Beginning in summer of 1990, the bodies of several women began turning up in and around the city of Vienna, Austria. From an extensive investigation by the Viennese police, it was determined that these murders were the work of one sadistic predator. Europe was dealing with a serial killer. With no experience with this kind of predator, Viennese police turned to the FBI. FBI profilers were able to identify a suspect in the murders. More ominously, they linked this same killer to murders committed in the United States.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On August 20, 1980, an unseen sniper murdered two young black men as they jogged with two white women in Salt Lake City, Utah. Police threw all their resources into finding a killer who left almost no clues behind. They met with FBI agents and detectives from around the country who had similar racially motivated sniper slayings. A month later, working off little more than a possible license plate number, police in Kentucky arrested Joseph Paul Franklin but the man escaped from custody.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: By April of 1995 in Washington, D.C., two officers had been shot and one had been murdered. Each had been sitting in their patrol cars when a man sneaked up and opened fire. The FBI was brought in to help catch the cop killer. Agents identified the man who was most likely the killer, but he was nowhere to be found. Months of surveillance operations around the country finally yielded a break; they found their suspect in Baltimore, MD.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On February 3, 1990, a 14-year-old girl ran away from her mother's home and disappeared without a trace. Her mother hoped Pasadena, Texas police could find her before it was too late. Six months later, their worst fear was realized when a farmer discovered the young girl's remains in an Illinois barn. The FBI was called in to help. Agents tracked down a trucker who they believed was responsible for 50 more deaths. Investigators knew they had to stop this menace of the highways.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When a Delaware woman vanished in 1996, family and friends discovered her secret life. The appointments secretary to the Governor had carried on an illicit affair with a wealthy married man. Agents suspected that her powerful ex-lover was responsible, but they had little physical evidence to support their theory. Investigators never found the woman's body or the murder weapon. The FBI's only hope was to go undercover, and turn brother against brother.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 90s, Washington, D.C. police were losing the battle against street gangs who enforced their territories with lethal violence. The homicide rate in the nation's capital climbed to the highest in the country. Local police turned to the FBI for help, but agents soon found themselves in the direct line of fire. In the fall of 1994, a gang member walked into police headquarters, killed two FBI agents and one detective, then turned the gun on himself.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In June of 1992, masked bandits pulled off a daring mid-day bank robbery. It marked the beginning of a four-year crime wave that rocked Seattle. With each new robbery, the bandits perfected their craft, leaving behind no evidence and escaping with hundreds and thousands of dollars. As the robbers became increasingly violent, pressure mounted to end their reign. With few leads, the FBI forced their own luck. The effort put them face to face with an armed and desperate fugitive.

programme.title: I Was Prey - Silent Scream

programme.title: I Was Prey - Blood in the Water

programme.title: Swamp Wars - Rattlesnake in My Car

programme.title: Swamp Wars - Monsters in the Backyard

programme.title: Swamp Wars - Florida's Born Killers

programme.title: Swamp Wars - Deer-Eating Python
programme.desc: A monstrous Burmese python poses a threat to the children of a day care center; the team extracts venom from a king cobra to be used as antidote.

programme.title: River Monsters - Body Snatcher
programme.desc: The rivers of Guyana may host a real freshwater mermaid that the locals call the Water Mama.

programme.title: River Monsters - River of Blood
programme.desc: Wade comes face-to-face with one of South America's greatest freshwater fighting fish.

programme.title: River Monsters - Amazon Apocalypse

programme.title: River Monsters - Man-Eating Monster
programme.desc: Wade hunts for the Lau-lau, a creature said to swallow men whole.

programme.title: River Monsters - Alaska's Cold Water Killer
programme.desc: A recent fatal incident in the Alaskan wilderness sends Jeremy on a quest for possible suspects that culminates in a showdown with an unexpected, bizarre water beast.

programme.title: River Monsters - South Pacific Terrors
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade fights through tropical storms and dangerous jungles to search for a Fijian killer that has been part of the local folklore for years, but there may be more than one.

programme.title: The Jeffersons
programme.desc: "We're moving on up, to the East Side, to a deee-luxe apartment in the sky ... ." This spinoff from "All in the Family" is about literal upward mobility - African- American couple George and Louise Jefferson move into a swanky high-rise building. George is an obstreperous, often rude guy who thinks his wealth should get him anywhere he wants to go. His wife is more levelheaded and often cuts him down to size when his schemes go awry.

It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: Match Game
programme.desc: Gene Rayburn hosts this comedy-game show hybrid in which contestants try to match answers given by celebrities to humorous, and often risque, fill-in-the-blank questions. The contestant with the most points at the end of the game advances to play the bonus round, in which the contestant has a chance to win thousands of dollars, with the actual amount dependent on the rules in place at the time of the episode.

programme.title: The Bishop's Wife
programme.desc: Dejected by his efforts to raise money to build a cathedral, Bishop Henry Brougham (David Niven) beseeches heaven for guidance, and is visited immediately by Dudley (Cary Grant), who claims to be an angel. Henry is skeptical, then annoyed when Dudley ingratiates himself into the household as his assistant -- and worse, wins the attentions of Henry's long-suffering and kindly wife (Loretta Young). When Dudley continues to intervene in Henry's struggles, the bishop decides to challenge heaven.

programme.title: Fiddler on the Roof
programme.desc: A lavishly produced and critically acclaimed screen adaptation of the international stage sensation tells the life-affirming story of Tevye, a poor milkman whose love, pride and faith help him face the oppression of turn-of-the-century czarist Russia.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon
programme.desc: Hiccup (Chris Sanders) is a Norse teenager from the island of Berk, where fighting dragons is a way of life. His progressive views and weird sense of humor make him a misfit, despite the fact that his father (Dean DeBlois) is chief of the clan. Tossed into dragon-fighting school, he endeavors to prove himself as a true Viking, but when he befriends an injured dragon he names Toothless, he has the chance to plot a new course for his people's future.

programme.title: Miracle on 34th Street
programme.desc: Six-year-old Susan Walker (Mara Wilson) is skeptical of the Christmas myth surrounding Santa Claus, a trait she perhaps learned from her mother, Dorey (Elizabeth Perkins). When tasked with hiring the Santa who will pose with kids at Macy's, Dorey enlists a man with the curious name of Kris Kringle (Richard Attenborough) who claims to be Santa himself. His assertions are met with scoffs and threats of institutionalization, but a young lawyer, along with Susan and Dorey, comes to his defense.

programme.title: Studio C

programme.title: The Sound of Music
programme.desc: A tuneful, heartwarming story, it is based on the real life story of the Von Trapp Family singers, one of the world's best-known concert groups in the era immediately preceding World War II. Julie Andrews plays the role of Maria, the tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey who becomes a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children, and brings a new love of life and music into the home.

programme.title: Miracle on 34th Street
programme.desc: In this Christmas classic, an old man going by the name of Kris Kringle (Edmund Gwenn) fills in for an intoxicated Santa in Macy's annual Thanksgiving Day parade. Kringle proves to be such a hit that he is soon appearing regularly at the chain's main store in midtown Manhattan. When Kringle surprises customers and employees alike by claiming that he really is Santa Claus, it leads to a court case to determine his mental health and, more importantly, his authenticity.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." programme.title: Let's Make a Deal
programme.desc: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: The NFL Today
programme.desc: Get ready for all of Sunday's game action on CBS with "The NFL Today." Hosted by James Brown, the hourlong show presents a mix of features, highlights, predictions and the latest news from across the league. Analysts alongside Brown include Nate Burleson, Bill Cowher, Russell Wilson and Kyle Long.

programme.title: Buffaloed
programme.desc: A woman is desperate to escape her life in Buffalo and finds a way by becoming a debt collector.

programme.title: The Whistlers
programme.desc: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera.

programme.title: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end.

programme.title: I Love You Forever
programme.desc: Following a young woman into and out of an emotionally abusive relationship.

programme.title: The Rover
programme.desc: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him.

programme.title: Aniara
programme.desc: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe.

programme.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
programme.desc: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait.

programme.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
programme.desc: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya.

programme.title: Epic
programme.desc: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans.

programme.title: The Flash
programme.desc: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for.

programme.title: Due Date
programme.desc: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan.

programme.title: The Hitcher
programme.desc: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders.

programme.title: My Soul to Take
programme.desc: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest.

programme.title: Holla
programme.desc: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness.

programme.title: The Darkest Minds
programme.desc: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven
programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

programme.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
programme.desc: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages.

programme.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
programme.desc: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason.

programme.title: Halloween: Resurrection
programme.desc: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive.

programme.title: Hall Pass
programme.desc: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality.

programme.title: Brian Banks
programme.desc: The inspirational true story of Brian Banks, an all-American high school football star who finds his life upended when he's wrongly convicted of a crime he didn't commit. Despite the lack of evidence, Banks gets railroaded through a broken justice system and sentenced to a decade of prison and probation. Years later, with the support of Justin Brooks and the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of playing in the NFL.

programme.title: Hoot
programme.desc: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds.

programme.title: Isle of Dogs
programme.desc: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture.

programme.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
programme.desc: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protégé, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush.

programme.title: The Switch
programme.desc: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him.

programme.title: Mid90s
programme.desc: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop.

programme.title: The Predator
programme.desc: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race.

programme.title: Solace
programme.desc: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer.

programme.title: Buffaloed
programme.desc: A woman is desperate to escape her life in Buffalo and finds a way by becoming a debt collector.

programme.title: The Whistlers
programme.desc: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera.

programme.title: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end.

programme.title: I Love You Forever
programme.desc: Following a young woman into and out of an emotionally abusive relationship.

programme.title: The Rover
programme.desc: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him.

programme.title: Aniara
programme.desc: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe.

programme.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
programme.desc: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait.

programme.title: Sydney White
programme.desc: Una estudiante (Amanda Bynes) universitaria une fuerzas con siete inadaptadas para apoderarse del gobierno estudiantil y promover un trato justo para todos los jóvenes.

programme.title: Baby Geniuses
programme.desc: Dos criminales experimentan con un niño y envían a su gemelo a una renombrada guardería de investigación.

programme.title: The Water Horse
programme.desc: En la orilla del Lago Ness, Angus encuentra un insólito huevo de caballo de agua, la legendaria criatura de la mitología escocesa. Angus intenta mantener oculta su existencia, hasta que su mascota se convierte en el legendario monstruo del Lago Ness.

programme.title: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Después de ser atrapados robando, Andy y su hermano menor Mark son enviados con un tío lejano a una isla misteriosa. Pronto descubren que su excéntrico abuelo desapareció sin dejar rastro décadas antes, llevándose el secreto de una gran fortuna.

programme.title: Planet 51
programme.desc: Un astronauta llega a un planeta donde los habitantes están atrapados en una versión de los Estados Unidos de los años cincuenta.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Un detective de poca monta descubre algo más que un simple secuestro en su búsqueda de la mascota desaparecida de los Miami Dolphins.

programme.title: Wild America
programme.desc: The fearless young Stouffer brothers -- Marty (Scott Bairstow), Mark (Devon Sawa) and Marshall (Jonathan Taylor Thomas) -- can hardly imagine going into the family business hawking auto parts in small-town Arkansas. With the begrudging approval of their no-nonsense father, the brothers set out on a dangerous cross-country camping trip, intending to capture on film their encounters with wild animals and the last remnants of the natural world in the rapidly vanishing American West.

programme.title: Jack and Jill
programme.desc: Thanksgiving is usually a happy time, but ad executive Jack (Adam Sandler) dreads the holiday because his twin sister, Jill (also Sandler), makes her annual visit. When Jack and his sister get off on the wrong foot, the only way to make it right is to invite her to stay through Hanukkah. But, when actor Al Pacino (Al Pacino), whom Jack desperately needs to star in a commercial, takes a shine to Jill, Jack may be forced to extend his sister's visit even longer.

programme.title: Last Action Hero
programme.desc: Following the death of his father, young Danny Madigan (Austin O'Brien) takes comfort in watching action movies featuring the indestructible Los Angeles cop Jack Slater (Arnold Schwarzenegger). After being given a magic ticket by theater manager Nick (Robert Prosky), Danny is sucked into the screen and bonds with Slater. When evil fictional villain Benedict (Charles Dance) gets his hands on the ticket and enters the real world, Danny and Jack must follow and stop him.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Boog (Martin Lawrence), a 900-pound grizzly bear, is content entertaining tourists and living in park ranger Beth's (Debra Messing) barn. His life takes a drastic turn when he rescues a one-horned mule deer named Elliot (Ashton Kutcher) from a hunter (Gary Sinise), and is subsequently tranquilized and returned to the wild. Elliot and Boog recruit the other animals, notably a Scottish squirrel (Billy Connolly) and a beaver foreman, to help turn the tables on the hunters to make the woods safe.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: An orphan in a facility run by the mean Miss Hannigan, Annie believes that her parents left her there by mistake. When a rich man named Oliver "Daddy" Warbucks decides to let an orphan live at his home to promote his image, Annie is selected. While Annie gets accustomed to living in Warbucks' mansion, she still longs to meet her parents. So Warbucks announces a search for them and a reward, which brings out many frauds.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction - The Ladybugs
programme.desc: Uncle Joe wants to cash in on the recent Beatlemania fever, by making up a girl group named The Ladybugs, starring his nieces and Sheriff Ragsdale's daughter.

programme.title: Circle Shorts
programme.desc: A bite-sized taste of country lifestyle, Southern travel, artist interviews and down-home food.

programme.title: Bonanza - San Francisco
programme.desc: Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.

programme.title: Bonanza - Bitter Water
programme.desc: When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

programme.title: Bonanza - Feet of Clay
programme.desc: The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.

programme.title: Bonanza - Dark Star
programme.desc: Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

programme.title: Bonanza - Death at Dawn
programme.desc: A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

programme.desc: Kate tries to restore the self-confidence of Floyd Smoot after he is jilted by his mail-order sweetheart, by pretending to be in love with him.

programme.desc: Gus (Robert Duvall) is injured during an Indian attack; Call (Tommy Lee Jones) has a final run-in with Blue Duck.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Die Musikerin Barbara Hannigan gewann den Grammy für das beste klassische Solo-Vokalalbum 2018 und wurde 2022 als Künstlerin des Jahres ausgezeichnet. Im Herbst 2023 gab sie ihr lang erwartetes Dirigentendebüt mit dem Cleveland Orchestra.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 2
programme.desc: J. S. Bachs Reihe der sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte gehört zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Zu ihrem 300-jährigen Jubiläum im Jahr 2021 spielten Václav Luks und das renommierte Barockensemble Collegium 1704 alle sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte.

programme.title: La Bayadère
programme.desc: La Bayadère ist ein Ballett in drei Akten des französischen Choreografen Marius Petipa. Es spielt im Indien des 19. Jahrhunderts und erzählt die traurige Liebesgeschichte des edlen Kriegers Solor und der Tempeltänzerin Nikia.

programme.title: Werke von Gluck, Bach und Mozart
programme.desc: Der in Venezuela geborene Dirigent Giovanni Guzzo leitet durch dieses 2024 in Madrid aufgezeichnete Konzert. Es standen Werke von Christoph Willibald Gluck, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart und Johann Sebastian Bach auf dem Programm.

programme.title: Mozart - Sinfonie Nr. 36 'Linz'
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchester in einem Konzert, in dem ein bezauberndes Werk von Mozart aufgeführt wird, das eine emotionale Verbindung zum Dirigenten hat: Die Symphonie Nr. 36 'Linz' ist nach der Heimatstadt von Welser-Möst.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise für zwei Klaviere Op. 77
programme.desc: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags spielt Martha Argerich Saint-Saëns Polonaise für Klavier Op. 77. Das Konzert wurde im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgezeichnet. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet.

programme.title: Mozart - Sinfonie Nr. 34, K. 338
programme.desc: Der Maestro Iván Fischer dirigiert das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem fesselnden Konzertprogramm mit Werken von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart und Antonín Dvořák. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

programme.title: Schönheit ist ein Verbrechen: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Teodor Currentzis dirigiert sein Musikensemble MusicAeterna und die Violinspielerin Patricia Kopatchinskaja in einem Konzertprogramm. Thema ist die Suche nach einer neuen Definition von Schönheit. Brahms und Mendelssohn werden in neues Licht gerückt.

programme.title: Werke von Bach, Bartók und Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer führt sein Budapest Festival Orchester mit Werken von Johann Sebastian Bach, Béla Bartók und Johannes Brahms. Die Aufführung wurde am 4. Dezember 2017 in der Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest aufgezeichnet.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-Fantasie, op. 61
programme.desc: Die in der Ukraine geborene Pianistin Inna Faliks spielt Frederic Chopins Polonaise-Fantasie Op. 61. Aufgenommen in der Nicols Konzert Hall in Evanston. Faliks hat sich als eine der poetischsten Künstlerinnen ihrer Generation etabliert.

programme.title: Von Weber: Der Freischutz
programme.desc: Die Sendung zeigt eine Produktion von Carl Maria von Webers "Der Freischütz" im Konzerthaus Berlin. Der Regisseur Carlus Padrissa beschreibt die Inszenierung mit der Theatergruppe La Fura dels Baus als eine Reise zu den Wurzeln der Oper.

programme.title: Waltons Bratschenkonzert & Brahms' Sinfonie Nr. 4
programme.desc: Robin Ticciati dirigiert das London Symphony Orchestra in Waltons Violakonzert und Brahms' Symphonie Nr. 4. Antoine Tamestit spielt als Solist, während das Konzert das jugendliche Genie Waltons und die leidenschaftliche Tiefe von Brahms vereint.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - Farinellis Vermächtnis
programme.desc: Als "Kastraten" werden männliche Sänger bezeichnet, die mit glockenklarer Stimme Tonhöhen des Soprans erreichen können, weil man sie noch vor dem Stimmbruch kastriert. Die Dokumentation beschäftigt sich mit dem Aufstieg bekannter Kastraten in der Geschichte und den Umständen, die ihre Karriere möglich machten. Außerdem sprechen die zwei Kontratenoren Max Emanuel Cencic und Philippe Jaroussky über die Musikentwicklung im Barock.

programme.title: Dvořák - Sinfonie Nr. 8 in G-Dur, op. 88
programme.desc: Anlässlich des 30-jährigen Jubiläums der Musikschule Reina Sofía in Madrid, Spanien, tourte das Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet durch Europa. Dieses Konzert wurde an der Franz-Liszt-Musikakademie in Budapest, Ungarn, aufgezeichnet.

programme.title: Schubert -- Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmete sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich der Kammermusik. Auf dem Programm standen unter anderem Felix Mendelssohns Klaviertrio Nr. 1 in d-Moll, Op. 49 und Franz Schuberts Rondo in A-Dur, D. 951.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

programme.title: Beethoven - - 5. Klavierkonzert, Op. 73
programme.desc: Die Berliner Philharmoniker Daniel Barenboim und Claudio Abbado brillierten beim Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen. Die beiden Freunde präsentierten Ludwig van Beethovens 5. Klavierkonzert sowie Johannes Brahms 2. Sinfonie.

programme.title: Kammermusik von Mozart und Schostakowitsch
programme.desc: Der Geiger Renaud Capuçon tritt beim Festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly auf und spielt Kammermusik aus dem klassischen Repertoire und dem Repertoire des 20. Jahrhunderts. Er tritt mit den Solisten der Internationalen Menuhin-Musikakademie auf.

programme.title: Beethoven - Septett in Es-Dur - Opus 20
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1991 trafen sich die Berliner Philharmoniker, um Kammermusikstücke einzuspielen. Eines von ihnen ist Beethovens Septett in Es-Dur, Op. 20. Diese Fassung der Solisten der Berliner Philharmoniker wurde in Prag aufgenommen.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
programme.desc: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht.

programme.title: Schostakowitsch - Concertino für zwei Klaviere
programme.desc: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Repertoire für Klavier und Violine in diesem wunderbaren Konzert, das im Château de Chantilly in Frankreich aufgezeichnet wurde.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen & Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchestra und den Chor in einem Konzert mit Werken von Richard Strauss, Metamorphosen, und Mozarts Requiem. Die Solisten sind Siobhan Stagg, Avery Amereau, Ben Bliss und Anthony Robin Schneider. Aufgenommen wurde dies in der Severance Hall, Cleveland im März 2023.

programme.title: Cooking Sessions with Tamar & Ms. E - Holiday Cooking Favorites
programme.desc: Tamar and Ms. E serve up some cozy Braxton holiday favorites in this episode. The kitchen is filled with comfort and joy as they simmer a rich, savory, tender beef stew and roll up classic, flavorful stuffed cabbage.

programme.title: Just Eats With Chef JJ - Family Favorites
programme.desc: Chef JJ's family favorites are front in center; he starts out with a fried catfish sandwich that's golden brown served with another favorite, fried plantains.

programme.title: Just Eats With Chef JJ - JJ's Family Sunday Dinner
programme.desc: JJ brings out the best for Sunday dinner! He cooks up slow cooked braised short ribs in a creamy gravy served with garlic mashed potatoes, and grilled asparagus. For dessert, it's a mixed berry compote over ice cream.

programme.title: Just Eats With Chef JJ - Kicked Up Turkey
programme.desc: Stylist/designer Ashlee Muhammad stops by, and Chef JJ makes her a kicked up turkey dinner, first it's a mixed berry rosemary rum smash, then it's braised turkey wings smothered in gravy and cabbage on the side.

programme.title: Just Eats With Chef JJ - Potluck With JJ
programme.desc: Chef JJ teams up with actress Katelyn Bennett for the ultimate potluck meal guaranteed to impress any crowd; they start with tender, smothered turkey wings drenched in savory gravy, served with truffle mashed potatoes.

programme.title: Just Eats With Chef JJ - Dinner Party Vibes
programme.desc: Chef JJ invites fellow Chef Jeff into his kitchen for a bold, flavor-packed meal centered around Caribbean warmth. He makes a spicy slow-cooked curried goat meal w/ vegetable in gravy. He tops the meal off with a creamy, refreshing coconut margarita.

programme.title: Just Eats With Chef JJ - Let Him Cook /No Rules
programme.desc: Chef JJ welcomes his good friend Sade Muhammad into his kitchen and makes a meal that is full of flavor. On the menu is curry chicken stew served with a side of garlicky sautéed kale. The experience is rounded out with an apple cider punch mocktail.

programme.desc: Nikki and professor Oglevee share a honeymoon suite after abandoning their fruitless search for Kim and Jerel.

programme.desc: Newlyweds Kim and Jerel make plans to move to Paris; professor Oglevee goes to great lengths to make Veronica jealous.

programme.title: The Parkers - Whassup With Heyyy?

programme.title: The Parkers - Scary Kim
programme.desc: Kim (Countess Vaughn) is terrorized by a trick-or-treater who bedevils her birthday bash on Halloween. Brandy, Shar Jackson and Lamont Bentley guest star.

programme.title: The Parkers - Election 2000
programme.desc: Kim and Nikki (Countess Vaughn, Mo'Nique) become rivals when they both run for student body president. Guest star: Tavis Smiley.

programme.desc: Kim portrays Nikki and professor Oglevee as rival hair-care barons in a story lifted from the TV show "Dallas."

programme.title: The Parkers - Cheers
programme.desc: When Nikki doesn't make the cheerleading squad, she and Kim rally the losers to form their own squad.

programme.title: The Parkers - Hands Off, Grandma
programme.desc: Nikki's recently widowed nana (guest star Isabel Sanford) tries to hook up with professor Oglevee (Dorien Wilson). J. Anthony Brown guest stars.

programme.title: The Parkers - Blind Date Mistake
programme.desc: Kim and Nikki (Countess Vaughn, Mo'Nique) are paired with a father and son (John Marshall Jones, Fred Thomas) on the TV show "Blind Date." Roger Lodge guest stars.

programme.title: Mama's Family
programme.desc: Thelma "Mama" Harper is the quick-tempered, blue-haired matriarch of the Harper family who lives with son Vint and his wife, Naomi, who were forced to move into Mama's basement after losing money in a business deal gone awry. After Vint's kids from a previous marriage leave the house, Mama's delinquent grandson Bubba is ordered to live with his grandmother after being released from juvenile hall and placed on probation. Iola Boylen, Thelma's friend and neighbor, is a frequent visitor to the Harper household, which is often the site of bickering between abrasive Mama and her loved ones. Vicki Lawrence stars as Mama, a character she originated in sketches on "The Carol Burnett Show."

programme.title: Totally '90s: House Hunters - Beverly Hills, 9021 - Oh No
programme.desc: Enjoy this 90s throwback episode of House Hunters! A couple relocates from Tennessee to Southern California, but their big move becomes difficult due to the difference in housing prices between their old and new neighborhoods.

programme.title: Ugliest House in America - The Ugliest of the Frontier
programme.desc: Retta's journey begins in the frontier region where four homes vie for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria; it's between an old green house, a cavernous dwelling, an eclectic cabin and a woody home with unique storage.

programme.title: Ugliest House in America - The West Coast Gets Ugly
programme.desc: Retta's ugly journey continues on the West Coast where four homes compete for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria; it includes a faux Scottish castle, a dome with zero privacy and a Hollywood house that feels more like a bar.

programme.title: Ugliest House in America - A Storm of Ugly in the Sunshine State
programme.desc: Retta's quest for ugly brings her to the Sunshine State, where three homes contend for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria; it includes a moody Miami mosaic mess and a dome home where the carpet has seen better days.

programme.title: Ugliest House in America - An Ugly Mess in the Midwest
programme.desc: Retta's journey to find ugly continues in the Midwest where four homes duke it out for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria; it includes a zombie doomsday castle, a flamingo-adorned lair and a textured carpeted dwelling.

programme.title: Ugliest House in America - The Hideous Heartland
programme.desc: The journey to find ugly continues in the Heartland where four homes battle for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria; it includes a powder blue art deco disaster, a condo overrun by artwork and an old colorful mansion.

programme.title: Ugliest House in America - The Ultimate Ugly Renovation
programme.desc: After a season-long search, Retta reveals the Ugliest House in America! Now, designer Alison Victoria faces her ultimate renovation challenge as she turns the winning home into a true showstopper with a stunning $150,000 makeover.

programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild - Fit for a King and Queen
programme.desc: Jack continues his trip across the US and explores a grandiose castle, a reimagined church, and a sprawling ranch; an open house welcomes potential buyers, but only one can be crowned the wildest of the bunch.

programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild - Secret Stash
programme.desc: Jack's adventure leads him to more unique homes: a former mobster's compound, a sprawling manor created by a beer mogul and an engineer's techy dream; an open house where one adventurous buyer could snatch up their new property.

programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild - Back to the Wild
programme.desc: Kicking things off at a house with a 727 airplane inside; exploring a pink time capsule-esque penthouse.

programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild - Bonkers Bunker
programme.desc: Exploring a secret underground residence 26 feet below the surface that features a full house, a front and backyard, and even a pool; time stands still here and proves that wild doesn't always have to be out in the open.

programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild - Worth the Wild
programme.desc: Jack McBrayer hits the road to see which home is worth the while; he begins his search at a Bavarian-themed lodge, explores a two-tower maze house filled with art and sculptures, then tours a home converted from a 19th-century church.

programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild - Choose Your Adventure
programme.desc: Things take an unusual turn as Jack steps into the '80s and visits a home featured in a popular supernatural show; a homeowner in Denmark shows off his digs, Jack visits a resort with 20 themed dwellings, a spaceship, a castle and a wizard's lair!

programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild - Large and In Charge
programme.desc: Jack explores an aviation-inspired home built on a lot previously leveled by wildfire; after an update about a successful wild home sale, Jack goes south to visit a replica of the White House.

programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild - Rock Out
programme.desc: Jack's wild adventures continue as he tours a townhome that's a love letter to Asheville, N.C.; he visits a crisp multi-dome that can withstand a natural disaster and tours a desert home that's carved into a mountain's natural bedrock.

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt - Spouses Search for a Deal
programme.desc: Married real estate agents make their living finding dream homes for clients in Pensacola Beach, Fla.; now, they want their own slice of paradise, but finding the perfect waterfront property on which they can both agree may be a challenge.

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt - Different Opinions of the Perfect Home in Matagorda, Texas
programme.desc: Mike and Marina have no doubt Matagorda, Texas, is the perfect place for a family vacation home; they must be able to agree on the property's location.

programme.title: House Hunters - Overcoming Debt in Charlotte
programme.desc: After working hard to get themselves out of debt, a couple is ready to buy their first home in Charlotte, N.C.; he's looking for mid-century modern in a rural area, but she prefers a more cozy and cottage-style home that's near the city.

programme.title: Totally '90s: House Hunters - Unmarried ... With Children
programme.desc: Enjoy this 90s throwback episode of House Hunters! A father sharing custody of his two young children wants to provide them with the perfect home; tired of the commute between his house and his children, he decides to move close to them.

programme.title: Totally '90s: House Hunters - First Step by Step
programme.desc: Enjoy this '90s throwback episode of House Hunters! Newlyweds are ready to buy their first home, and the groom's parents happily accompany the young couple on their house hunt.

programme.title: Totally '90s: House Hunters - Fresh Crib of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Enjoy this '90s throwback episode of House Hunters! Three generations of women are looking for a new home to share in the city after spending five years together in the suburbs.

programme.title: Totally '90s: House Hunters - In Living Color and Beige
programme.desc: Enjoy this 90s throwback episode of House Hunters! A couple living happily in a duplex apartment is ready to buy their own house; discouraged by the quality of homes available, they hope to find a new realtor to get them back on track.

programme.title: Totally '90s: House Hunters - Growing Pains
programme.desc: Enjoy this 90s throwback episode of House Hunters! A family of four is looking for a house that will give them room to grow. They need a home with four bedrooms and a larger yard, but finding one with a swimming pool would be a big plus.

programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.desc: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: Let's Make a Deal ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.desc: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. programme.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: Let's Make a Deal ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

programme.desc: Following Adam and Emma on their daily commute from the village of Langton to London, where they meet the same passengers every day.

programme.title: Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: When her teenage daughter opts out of Thanksgiving, single mother Claudia Larson (Holly Hunter) travels alone to her childhood home for an explosive holiday dinner with her dysfunctional family. Claudia quickly tires of her parents, her long-suffering sister (Cynthia Stevenson), her snobby brother-in-law (Steve Guttenberg) and her nutty aunt (Geraldine Chaplin). This time, the masked killer has set his sights on pretty disc jockey Vanita "Stretch" Brock (Caroline Williams), who teams up with Texas lawman Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) to battle the psychopath and his family deep within their lair, a macabre abandoned amusement park.

programme.title: Red Eye

She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

When the Vatican gets word of Frankie's situation, a high-ranking cardinal (Jonathan Pryce) requests that the Rev. Andrew Kiernan (Gabriel Byrne) investigate her case. Soon Kiernan realizes that very sinister forces are at work, and tries to rescue Frankie from the entity that is plaguing her.

The clique known as the Blue Ribbons are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect. When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes).

When the job goes badly, Wanda attempts to seduce George's stuffy lawyer, Archie Leach (John Cleese), to find out where George hid the diamonds. Meanwhile, Ken repeatedly attempts to kill an elderly woman (Patricia Hayes) who witnessed the robbery.

They exist only to hit on women at discos, though they're routinely unsuccessful until a chance run-in with Richard Grieco gets them inside the swank Roxbury club. Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own.

programme.title: The Dictator

Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule.

programme.title: Barbershop

After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy and struggles with the notion that he just sold it out.

However, his sheer determination and his impassioned speeches ready his men for the bloodiest of battles -- Agincourt.

Against the backdrop of the horrific Battle of Saipan, when capture is imminent, Enders is forced to make a decision: if he can't protect his fellow Marine, can he bring himself to kill him to protect the code?

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides - Everything But the Kitchen Sink

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides - Ready to Run
programme.desc: The Ridler car's engine and transmission are married for the last time and installed, and the team moves on to the wiring and other systems. As the car is prepped to fire up for the first time, a dent threatens to stop the whole build in its tracks.

programme.desc: One of Dave's all-time favorite designs is the Mercedes Gullwing, and a new client arrives with a kit version of the car; the car kit has many flaws, which the team needs to address while trying to get the car as close as they can to the original.

programme.desc: A '41 Chevy that has bounced around numerous shops rolls in for a quick trunk lid fix, but things go south very quickly; as if the shop wasn't busy enough, they kick off a Road Tour and the garage turns into an ER for broken down cars.

Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination.

programme.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
programme.desc: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."
